messages.subject: Snapclust and HWE/PANMIXIA assumptions
parts:
Hello Zhian and everyone,

Does somebody know if the clustering functions Snapclust or find.clusters(), can be applied to populations that are NOT UNDER HWE and are NOT PANMITIC? For example Pops with mixed reproduction systems (both clonal and sexual components present).

Vanina
